flashcard_questions.q: The differences in characteristics between individuals of the same species.
Variation caused by differences in DNA inherited from parents, including through mutations, meiosis, and sexual reproduction.
The chemical molecule that carries the genetic instructions for the development and functioning of living organisms, found in the nucleus of cells.

flashcard_questions.a: Variation caused by the conditions in which an organism lives, such as diet, climate, or lifestyle.
A random change in the sequence of bases in DNA, which may alter the protein produced by a gene.
